Description: Elastic Load Balancers found using unencrypted (HTTP) listeners instead of secure HTTPS or SSL/TLS listeners.
Risk: Using HTTP listeners allows data to be transmitted in plaintext across the network, exposing sensitive information, user credentials, and session tokens to interception and eavesdropping.

Recommendation.Text: Delete HTTP listeners or configure them to redirect all HTTP requests to a secure HTTPS listener. Ensure all active listeners use encrypted protocols.
